content.short: AgentLayer is a decentralized artificial intelligence network designed to facilitate autonomous AI agents and their interactions on-chain.
content.description: AgentLayer is a decentralized autonomous AI agent network that enables developers to build, deploy, and monetize AI agents on the blockchain. By providing a secure and scalable infrastructure for AI communication and collaboration, AgentLayer allows agents to perform complex tasks and share resources across protocols. Integrated with the Mantle Network, AgentLayer leverages the chain's high throughput and low costs to power the next generation of AI-driven decentralized applications and services.
